newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Amsterdam exchange to overhaul Eurotop 100 index.
newsitem.headline: Amsterdam exchange to overhaul Eurotop 100 index.

text.p: Amsterdam's European Options Exchange said on Monday it planned a far-reaching overhaul of its Eurotop 100 index, changing the weighting criteria and denominating contracts on the index in guilders.
It said that from December 23 options and futures contracts on the Eurotop 100 index would be denominated in guilders rather than ecu.

The switch from ecu to guilders had been prompted by waning demand for ecu contracts and the fact that the automatic conversion of ecus into euros after the advent of a single European currency had never been formalised, EOE said.
"By contrast the Dutch guilder is assured of an automatic conversion into euros," it said in a statement.
"The EOE Options Exchange expects to generate more turnover as a result of this change," the statement added.
The options exchange added that from April next year, the index would be compiled on the basis of market capitalisation, in line with international practice.
At present index weightings are determined on the basis of an issue's effective turnover on its national exchange.
"As a result of these changes the index will offer a more reliable and accurate picture of the trends on Europe's leading share markets," EOE said.
